LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_PawnStatusTip: This permanent qualification belongs to the personality and is recorded separately from the current SSC identity and global research state. It survives leaving Master identity and transfers through personality gel; clones do not inherit it. Bonding still restricts identity changes.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_DirectSelectionO: Direct manual Master selection is enabled: an unqualified pawn may choose Master, but choosing that identity does not grant permanent qualification. This setting does not supply research techprints.

Direct manual Master selection is disabled: an unqualified pawn must first use a Master qualification module to choose Master. Disabling the setting removes neither existing identity nor permanent qualification.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_GelStatusTip: This is the qualification stored in the gel's personality. Implantation replaces the host's previous personality qualification. Extraction, copying and processing preserve this record; clones do not inherit it. Research progress and techprints from the original save do not transfer.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_InvalidPawn: This pawn cannot acquire Master qualification.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_Slave: SSC sex slaves cannot use a Master qualification module.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_Unavailable: Master qualification item or research data is unavailable.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_Granted: {0} has permanently acquired Master qualification and can choose Master in the identity menu.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_DebugSpawnTip: Spawn one module near the selected object on the current map, or at the map center if no map object is selected. Does not directly grant qualification.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_DebugUnavailable: Requires a loaded map and the Master qualification module definition.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualification_DebugSpawnFailed: Cannot place the Master qualification module. Try another map or selected location.
